correctness.rationale: In any finite idempotent unary algebra f^2=f, every coordinate term is u_i or f(u_i), so a complete parameter-free quantifier-free atomic diagram is its equality partition on those 2k formal terms. Distinct values group by fixed image. A root group with b>0 distinct leaves and optional root contributes y^b(1+y)/b!, whereas root-only contributes y. Unlabeled root-group multisets contribute 1/nu_b!, and Hall feasibility reduces exactly to sorted distinct-leaf demands d_j<=c_j, j<=t<=r. Their y-polynomial enumerates injective-value diagrams in exponential convention; substituting e^x-1 assigns nonempty coordinate-preimage blocks and gives T_k=sum a_d d! S(k,d). Each realized diagram is individually definable, so its Boolean algebra has 2^T_k subsets. For c<e coordinatewise, any new feasible diagram must have j groups each >c_j leaf demand, requiring k>=j(c_j+1); choosing j groups of c_j+1 leaves for an attaining index realizes a new diagram in e, and repetition extends it to all k>=k*. Independent direct tuple enumeration recovers separations (2,1,0)<(3,1,0) at k=3, (3,1)<(3,2) at k=4, (0,0)<(1,0) at k=1. Source 197 instances and 2249 comparisons are finite corroboration. The proof also covers root-only and k=0 boundary.
